NAME:
   rancher telemetry - Local usage recording: status, turn on, turn off, delete, list and send events

USAGE:
   rancher telemetry [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   off:     Turn usage recording off and delete what is recorded
   on:      Turn usage recording on
   reset:   Delete what is recorded and keep the telemetry key
   show:    List the recorded events
   status:  Show whether usage recording is on and what is recorded, and any active experiments
   upload:  Send the stored usage events now (development builds with the telemetryupload experiment)

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
